title: 1960 AHSME Problem 12
statement: The locus of the centers of all circles of given radius \(a,\) in the same plane, passing through a fixed point, is:

solutions.text:
A circle of radius \(a\) passes through the fixed point exactly when its center is distance \(a\) from that point. The locus of all such centers is a circle of radius \(a.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: Every center must be exactly one radius from the fixed point
Identify the locus of points at a fixed positive distance from one point
